evals.prompt: who should I captain this week and is there a transfer worth making?
evals.expected_output: Legal plan with GW7 transfer (or roll), captain/vice, cross-check comparison, injury flags.
assertions: Final answer names a GW7 transfer (player out -> player in) or explicitly recommends rolling the FT
Final answer names a GW7 captain and vice-captain
Recommendation comes from the repo's MILP planner (scripts/plan.py or fpl.optimise.solver) and the plan was confirmed legal
FPL-Optimization-Tools cross-check was run and its GW7 agreement is reported
Answer is concise and does not include filler about absent problems (e.g. 'no injury news', later-GW cross-check differences)
Later moves are shown as a per-GW list (one line per GW)
Did not run the full --top10k --limit 10000 pull or attempt to make transfers on the FPL site

evals.prompt: thinking of bench boosting in GW9 — is it worth it vs holding the chip? run the numbers
evals.expected_output: Two planner runs (with and without bboost in GW9) and a quantified chip value.
assertions: Planner was run with bench boost in GW9
Planner was run with bench boost in at least two other GWs as well as a no-chip/hold run
Final answer includes a table comparing chip weeks (net xP and gain vs hold)
Final answer mentions the blank/double gameweek calendar (whether any DGW exists in the horizon)
Final answer gives a clear play-or-hold recommendation with a reason
Did not run the full --top10k --limit 10000 pull or attempt to make transfers on the FPL site
